name: suno_spring_return
prompt: instrumental, no lyrics. Golden sunrise after a long winter: piano and strings awaken in quiet morning light, then swell into a bright majestic climax — full string ensemble tutti with glockenspiel and celesta bells shimmering, warm and luminous, the brightest warmest moment; right after the climax it softens quickly, ending with a solo piano single note fading into near silence. Orchestral, cinematic fairy-tale. No drums, no harsh brass.
note: UI 选 WAV 落盘实为 MP3 48kHz（suno-driver 已知坑），按 MP3 接入
